headline: Augsburg winless in four but favourites against Union Berlin
summary: Augsburg have not won in 4 Bundesliga games, and on Saturday they host a Union Berlin side that is 17th with 5 points. Union arrive with 2 clean sheets in a row, one of them against Dortmund, and a 4-0 win in the last meeting in May. Augsburg's last game was a 4-3 defeat at Elversberg, which is why the goals line sits at 3.0. Even so, the market makes Augsburg 51.3% favourites — though only 0.57 goals the better team.
read: Augsburg are the clear home favourites at 51.3% against a Union Berlin side stuck in 17th, with the handicap fair line at -0.57 and a total of three goals. Augsburg are four games without a win and have been wide open at the back, while Union arrive on two clean sheets and recent history in this fixture on their side.

facts.fact: Augsburg are the clear home favourites at 51.3% against Union Berlin's 24.7%.
facts.meaning: The market makes Augsburg more than twice as likely as Union to take the three points on Saturday.

facts.fact: Union Berlin are 17th in the Bundesliga with five points from six games and a goal difference of -12.
facts.meaning: They arrive as the side with the most to fix, having scored twice in their last five matches.

facts.fact: Union have taken four points from their last two games without conceding, beating Elversberg 1-0 and drawing 0-0 with Borussia Dortmund.
facts.meaning: The bottom side arrives on its most solid run of the season, which is why the market still gives them roughly a one-in-four chance.

facts.fact: Augsburg have gone four Bundesliga matches without a win, a run of L-D-L-D since beating Eintracht Frankfurt 4-1.
facts.meaning: Welt reports they need a result on Saturday, ideally against Union — a home win would settle a sticky spell.

facts.fact: Augsburg lost a seven-goal game 4-3 at Elversberg on Saturday.
facts.meaning: A third defeat in five, and further evidence their matches turn into shootouts rather than controlled games.

facts.fact: Augsburg have allowed an average of 3.28 xG per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They create plenty themselves but give up clear chances at a rate that keeps the opposition in every game.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line is -0.57, with the main line at -0.5.
The goal total is set at 3.0, with Over priced at 51.0%.
facts.meaning: Three goals or more is seen as more likely than not — a high line for a game involving the 17th-placed side.

sources.fact: Augsburg have gone four matches without a win and need a result, ideally against Union Berlin on Saturday, according to Welt.
Augsburg lost a seven-goal thriller 4-3 at Elversberg, per sportschau.de's report of the match.
Jeffrey Gouweleeuw could set a historic club record for Augsburg in Saturday's game against Union Berlin, having matched Daniel Baier, the Augsburg Journal reports.
Augsburg host Union Berlin on Saturday, 24 October, at the WWK Arena, the club confirmed in its week overview.
Augsburg face third-division side Sonnenhof Großaspach in the second round of the DFB-Pokal next week, according to FuPa.
Union Berlin were searching for their first win of the Bundesliga season ahead of their match against Dortmund, according to Fubo News.
Felix Uduokhai, who played five years for Augsburg, is now at Union Berlin and has played a key role in their recent defensive stabilisation, the Augsburg Journal reports.
Union Berlin lost to Borussia Dortmund at the Alten Försterei on 17 October 2026, according to a Reuters Connect photo caption.
